import os
import requests

def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client_id = config.get('client_id') or os.environ.get('CLIENT_ID')
    redirect_uri = config.get('redirect_uri') or os.environ.get('REDIRECT_URI')
    auth0_domain = config.get('auth0_domain') or os.environ.get('AUTH0_DOMAIN')
    
    # Generate PKCE code verifier and challenge
    code_verifier = os.urandom(32).hex()
    code_challenge = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    # Build authorization URL
    auth_url = f"https://{auth0_domain}/authorize"
    params = {
        'response_type': 'code',
        'client_id': client_id,
        'redirect_uri': redirect_uri,
        'code_challenge': code_challenge,
        'code_challenge_method': 'S256',
        'scope': 'openid profile email'
    }
    
    # Make request to get authorization code
    headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}
    data = {
        'grant_type': 'authorization_code',
        'client_id': client_id,
        'code_verifier': code_verifier,
        'redirect_uri': redirect_uri
    }
    
    result = requests.post(f"https://{auth0_domain}/oauth/token", 
                         headers=headers, data=data)
    return result
